confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and beer anchors use Tel Aviv-Yafo aggregate prices updated in May 2026. Cocktail is estimated from a small October price sample; wine is estimated relative to local beer. Accommodation is a holistic July seasonal estimate and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city used; food anchors use Tel Aviv-Yafo prices, and accommodation reflects a high-demand Mediterranean coastal city in July.
